nodes.label: Chat turn
nodes.summary: The user sends a message in a chat and Flightdeck runs one headless `claude -p` turn, streaming its events back into the chat live.

nodes.label: Compose message
nodes.summary: The composer sends the text plus any attached map-node references to the server.

nodes.label: Resolve node context
nodes.summary: The messages endpoint sets the chat title and resolves attached nodes from the map files on disk, so the UI can only point at nodes and never inject text.

nodes.label: Spawn claude -p
nodes.summary: startTurn records a run and spawns the CLI with the session id, the mode's model, the Discuss prompt, the hook settings and no API key in the environment.

nodes.label: Parse stream-json
nodes.summary: Each stdout line is parsed as a Claude event; a non-subscription apiKeySource aborts the run, and everything else is appended to the chat feed.

nodes.label: Append to feed
nodes.summary: Feed items go to an append-only JSONL file per chat and out to live subscribers.

nodes.label: SSE feed stream
nodes.summary: The feed endpoint replays the whole JSONL file, sends a 'replayed' marker, then streams live items with keep-alive pings and no nginx buffering.

nodes.label: Derive and render
nodes.summary: The client folds feed items into messages, tool activity lines, approval cards and notes, and works out which files the latest run read or edited.

nodes.label: Light up map
nodes.summary: The chat's map pane marks the nodes whose files the run read (blue) or edited (amber).

nodes.label: Stop button
nodes.summary: stopTurn cancels any open approval cards and sends SIGINT so the turn ends cleanly and is recorded.

nodes.label: Finish run
nodes.summary: When the process exits, the run is marked finished, failed or stopped with git HEAD after, the edit lock is released and leftover cards are cancelled.

nodes.label: Tool approval hook
nodes.summary: Claude Code calls Flightdeck's PreToolUse HTTP hook before every tool use, and Flightdeck allows it, denies it, or holds it until the user clicks an approval card.

nodes.label: Receive hook call
nodes.summary: POST /hook on loopback parses the payload; an unreadable payload is denied.

nodes.label: Find active run
nodes.summary: The session id is matched to a chat with a running turn; with no running turn, the call is denied.

nodes.label: Mode and edit lock
nodes.summary: Edits are refused in Discuss mode, or when another chat in the project holds the edit lock.

nodes.label: Evaluate project rules
nodes.summary: The project's allow/deny rules are matched against the tool and its input; output redirection is never covered by an allow rule.

nodes.label: Show approval card
nodes.summary: In the Ask case, a pending approval is recorded and pushed to the feed with a suggested pattern, and Claude Code waits until it is answered or times out.

nodes.label: User decides
nodes.summary: The card posts allow (optionally 'always allow' with a pattern) or deny with a reason.

nodes.label: Resolve approval
nodes.summary: resolveApproval saves any always-allow rule, settles the approval in the DB and feed, and wakes the waiting hook.

nodes.label: Answer Claude Code
nodes.summary: The decision goes back as a PreToolUse permissionDecision, and an allowed edit takes the project's edit lock.

nodes.label: Generate a map
nodes.summary: A read-only Claude agent explores a project and returns an architecture, data-model or flows map as structured output, which is validated and written to .flightdeck/.

nodes.label: Request generation
nodes.summary: 'Map this project' or 'Refresh map' posts to the generate endpoint for the current view.

nodes.label: Spawn mapping agent
nodes.summary: startGeneration allows one job per project and runs `claude -p` with the view prompt, a JSON schema, disallowed write tools and its own hook.

nodes.label: Read-only hook
nodes.summary: /hook/map allows only read, search and git-inspection tools for the job's session, with no cards; everything else is refused.

nodes.label: Track progress
nodes.summary: Tool-use events update the job's step count and activity line, which the UI polls every 2 s.

nodes.label: Validate map
nodes.summary: validateMap rejects structural problems (duplicate ids, unknown parents, cycles) and drops missing files and bad edges, keeping a warning for each.

nodes.label: Write .flightdeck file
nodes.summary: The map is stored with its commit, model and warnings as .flightdeck/<view>.json in the project repo.

nodes.label: Browse a map
nodes.summary: The Map screen loads a stored map, flags nodes whose files changed since it was made, and lets the reader drill down and open files.

nodes.label: Load map
nodes.summary: useMap fetches the view and polls it; the server reads .flightdeck/<view>.json.

nodes.label: Detect changes
nodes.summary: changedSince diffs the map's commit against the working tree, and staleNodeIds marks the covering nodes and their ancestors.

nodes.label: Draw and drill
nodes.summary: MapCanvas lays out the current level with React Flow and ELK; double-click or breadcrumbs move between levels.

nodes.label: Node panel
nodes.summary: The side panel shows the selected node's summary, fields, stale warning and files.

nodes.label: View file
nodes.summary: The file viewer fetches a file or directory listing that is confined to the project and never shows .git.

nodes.label: Discuss node in chat
nodes.summary: 'Discuss in a new chat' on a map node creates a chat with that node already attached to its first message.

nodes.label: Click Discuss
nodes.summary: The node panel hands the node reference to the app.

nodes.label: Create chat
nodes.summary: The app creates a chat (new session id, Discuss mode) and records the node handoff for it.

nodes.label: Prefill context
nodes.summary: ChatView opens with the node as a context chip, ready to send with the next message.

nodes.label: Add a project
nodes.summary: Registers an existing git repository on the box as a project and gives it the starting approval rules.

nodes.label: Submit path
nodes.summary: The sidebar form posts a folder path and an optional name.

nodes.label: Check folder
nodes.summary: The server requires an absolute path to an existing directory that is a git repo and isn't already a project.

nodes.label: Insert with rules
nodes.summary: The project row is saved with the default models, and the template rules are copied in.

nodes.label: Edit project settings
nodes.summary: Project settings screen to change the default Discuss/Build models and to add or delete approval rules.

nodes.label: Settings screen
nodes.summary: Lists rules and the model defaults, and sends changes.

nodes.label: Rules/settings API
nodes.summary: The endpoints insert or delete rules and update the project's models in SQLite.

nodes.label: Gateway request
nodes.summary: Requests from the SSO gateway arrive on the docker0 listener, which only serves them when they carry the secret header and never exposes the hook endpoints.

nodes.label: Gateway listener
nodes.summary: Starts only if FLIGHTDECK_GATEWAY_HOST is set and the secret is at least 32 bytes.

nodes.label: Filter request
nodes.summary: Paths under /hook get 404, and a missing or wrong X-Flightdeck-Gateway secret (compared in constant time) gets 403.

nodes.label: Serve app
nodes.summary: Accepted requests go to the same Hono app: the API, SSE and the built web UI.
